description.en:
Presents a new objective: it stops the map BGM (10 frames), opens and plays the jingle _jng, makes the objective display blink (CMND_SET_PURPOSE_STATE on and off every 20 frames, ending on), waits for the jingle to end and closes it. Unless _bgm_fade_off is true, it then plays the map BGM again (volume 1.0, 10 frames).
No event calls it directly: SetGameSubPhase (with its effect flag) and OutlineEffect do.
true to leave the map BGM stopped.
